headline: Petrol and diesel, the bill swells: in Friuli Venezia Giulia families and businesses will spend 334 million more
summary: CGIA estimates that fuel price increases will cost families and businesses in Friuli Venezia Giulia 334 million euros more in 2026. That is a 20.1% rise compared with last year.
why: Fuel costs feed into transport, logistics and household spending, and regional fuel price trends affect Italian inflation.
